# shopcos soft

shopcos soft is offline-first point of sale (POS) billing software for retail shops, made by COS — Chishti Office Samundri (Samundri, Faisalabad, Pakistan). It handles fast barcode billing, inventory and stock control, a khata/udhar customer credit ledger, supplier accounts, day closing, and sales and profit reports, with a built-in AI assistant in Urdu and English. It works 100% offline on a Windows PC in the shop, with a companion Android app. Licenses are one-time payments (lifetime license, no monthly subscription), and a 30-day free trial is available with no card required.

## What it is

- Retail POS / billing software for small and medium shops
- Runs locally on the shop's own Windows PC — internet is not required for daily use
- One-time purchase with a lifetime license; no monthly fees
- 30-day free trial (full Business plan features), no credit card required

## Key features

- Fast barcode billing with product photos, auto-barcode for new products, and company barcode quick-add
- Inventory and stock management with low-stock alerts and expiry tracking (batch number and generic name fields for pharmacies/medical stores)
- Khata/udhar customer credit ledger with WhatsApp bill sharing and payment reminders
- Supplier and purchase accounts
- Day closing and audit log
- Sales and profit reports
- Built-in AI assistant ("shopcos AI agent") in Urdu and English for smart insights such as stock prediction and udhar alerts
- Staff roles: Admin (full access), Editor (products/stock/rates, no AI or user management), User (billing only — staff never see purchase rates)
- Offline mode with cloud sync when internet is available; multi-shop data isolation
- Country, currency, and language selection built in

## Pricing

All plans are a one-time payment for a lifetime license. There are no monthly subscription fees.

- Starter: $90 (Rs 25,000)
- Business: $145 (Rs 40,000)
- Professional: $290 (Rs 80,000)
- Enterprise: $545 (Rs 150,000)
- Free trial: 30 days, full Business plan, no card required

Payment methods: Easypaisa, JazzCash, bank transfer, Google Pay, and crypto.

## Platforms

- Windows desktop (PC software — billing, stock, reports, AI assistant)
- Android (companion mobile app, syncs with the shop PC in real time over the local network)

## Languages and countries

- Interface languages: English (default) and Urdu
- Supports 31 countries and 28 currencies

## Who it is for

- Kiryana and general stores
- Pharmacies and medical stores
- Garments and clothing shops
- Bakeries
- All retail shops that need billing, stock, and credit-ledger management
